mapper.select: select count(1) from documents where id=#{orderId} and type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and approval_status='APPROVED' and deleted='0'
select count(1) from warehouses where id=#{warehouseId} and enabled='1'

select l.id order_line_id,l.name item_snapshot,l.quantity_q4 order_quantity,coalesce(sum(r.quantity_q4),0) received_quantity, l.quantity_q4-coalesce(sum(r.quantity_q4),0) remaining_quantity from purchase_order_lines l left join receipt_lines r on r.order_line_id=l.id where l.order_id=#{orderId} and l.is_current='1' group by l.id,l.name,l.quantity_q4 order by l.line_no for update
mapper.update: update number_sequences set next_value=next_value+1 where document_type='RECEIPT' and business_date=#{businessDate}
mapper.select: select next_value from number_sequences where document_type='RECEIPT' and business_date=#{businessDate}
mapper.update: update documents set current_version=1,revision=revision+1,update_time=now() where id=#{documentId} and type='RECEIPT' and current_version=0 and deleted='0'
